chunks: And among His signs is the creation of the heavens and the earth and what He has dispersed throughout them of living creatures, and He is Able to gather them together whenever He wills.
ai.seo_question: What are the signs of God's power in creation and resurrection according to Surah Ash-Shura?
ai.summary: In Shia exegesis, this verse is often linked with the preceding verse (42:29) to illustrate the dual aspects of God's power: His creative act (khaliq) and His regenerative power (ba'ith). The mention of 'dabbah' (creatures) encompasses all living beings, reinforcing the universality of the resurrection (ma'ad) which is central to Shia eschatology. This connection underscores that the same Divine Will that initiated creation is fully capable of reassembling it for the final judgment.
